posts.title: Why compression should be part of your agent harness
posts.description: How you can use deterministic filtering, grouping, and formatting to reduce agent context, then use semantic compression and prompt rewrites separately. Practical examples from RTK, Caveman, and Ponytail.

posts.title: Tool calling is broken without MCP Server Composition
posts.description: Most agents fail not at reasoning, but at picking and using the right tools. This post explains how Model Context Protocol (MCP) server composition fixes that with four practical patterns.
